correctness.rationale: Bounded truncated logarithms make stationarity rigorous without logarithmic integrability. Convex Jensen drift on x<=1/2 is nonnegative and supported within (0,e^{-M}/gamma); its stationary integral vanishes by finite-measure continuity. Strict right-branch drift excludes all (1/2,1); exact finite open-set reachability from each lower point then excludes (0,1/2] using stationarity for all n. Both endpoints are fixed. The root uniqueness and normalized mean-log relation are explicit.
